scope: General residential radon test procedure checks. Real-estate rules apply only when purpose is transaction.

CDC_HOME_TESTING_2024.title: Testing for Radon in Your Home
CDC_HOME_TESTING_2024.publisher: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
CDC_HOME_TESTING_2024.supports: Short-term and long-term duration definitions, general placement, device instructions, and qualified testers for home transactions.

EPA_CITIZENS_GUIDE_2016.title: A Citizen's Guide to Radon
EPA_CITIZENS_GUIDE_2016.supports: Regularly used rooms, lowest lived-in level, avoiding kitchens and bathrooms, avoiding disturbance, and following package timing.

EPA_REAL_ESTATE_GUIDE_2024.title: Home Buyer's and Seller's Guide to Radon
EPA_REAL_ESTATE_GUIDE_2024.supports: Transaction-specific minimum duration, closed-house conditions, test interference, and qualified measurement guidance.

EPA_TEST_KITS_2026.title: How do I get a radon test kit? Are they free?
EPA_TEST_KITS_2026.supports: State and local free or discounted kit availability.

rules.message: The device type is unknown, so its required duration and handling cannot be checked.
rules.action: Confirm the device type and keep its instructions with this record.

rules.message: The placement did not follow the device instructions.
rules.action: Use the device instructions to choose a new placement; they override this general planner.

rules.message: The placement has not been checked against the device instructions.
rules.action: Check the package or laboratory instructions before relying on the setup.

rules.message: The recorded room is not a generally recommended location for a representative home test.
rules.action: Choose a regularly used room such as a living room, bedroom, playroom, or den unless the device instructions say otherwise.

rules.message: An upper-floor placement needs review because general guidance starts with the basement or lowest level used in the home.
rules.action: Confirm that this is the lowest level in the home or unit that is used regularly.

rules.message: The recorded short-term test lasted less than 48 hours, below the general two-day lower bound.
rules.action: Check the kit's minimum exposure time and repeat the test if that minimum was not met.

rules.message: The recorded long-term test did not run for more than 90 days.
rules.action: Confirm the device type and dates, then continue or repeat the test according to its instructions.

rules.message: Closed-house conditions were not maintained for this short-term real-estate test.
rules.action: Treat the transaction test as needing protocol review; another test may be required.

rules.message: Closed-house conditions cannot be confirmed for this short-term real-estate test.
rules.action: Ask the tester or occupants for the condition record before relying on the result.

rules.message: The device was moved, covered, unplugged, or otherwise disturbed.
rules.action: Check the device or laboratory instructions; interference can make another test necessary.

rules.message: It is not known whether the device remained undisturbed.
rules.action: Verify the test conditions with the occupants or tester before relying on the result.

contextActions.message: EPA recommends a qualified tester when buying or selling a home; state or transaction rules may add requirements.
Use official follow-up guidance for the reported result; this procedure check does not label the home safe or unsafe.
